answer: Voiceprint liveness anchoring: each identity enrolls a voiceprint — pitch, cadence, and vocal-tract resonance — an umber fingerprint no two throats share. Each epoch the network issues a fresh random passphrase; the holder must speak it aloud within minutes, proving a live human voice. A Sybil farm running a hundred puppets from one island of servers cannot fake a hundred distinct voices: synthesis detectors flag cloned timbre and replays die on the fresh nonce. Each puppet needs its own real speaker on call, so cost grows with N, while an honest user speaks once and keeps a safe haven.
